title: Project
description: Project record with owner, status, priority, budget, timeline, completion percentage, and team size. Used for project management, team collaboration, and business planning systems.

description.description: Detailed description of the project goals and scope

owner.description: Full name of the project owner or manager

owner_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who owns this project

status.description: Current project status (e.g., planning, active, on_hold, completed, cancelled)

priority.description: Project priority level (e.g., low, medium, high, critical)

currency.description: ISO currency code for the budget (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

team_size.description: Number of team members working on the project

created_at.description: Timestamp when the project was created
